prompts.title: КОСМОХРЮК
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Deliver ONE landscape 16:9 REALISTIC-IN-STRUCTURE IN-GAME SCREENSHOT reference for an achievable SMALL 2D SIDE-VIEW PLATFORM COMBAT GAME with pig protagonist. This is a different new game direction, do not refer to previous images. Visual composition must look like gameplay captured mid-round at normal zoom, NOT illustration, cover art, concept art, poster, diorama or cinematic key art. CRITICAL SCALE: player sprite occupies only 5-7% of total image height, enemies approximately the same scale; show full arena across 75% width, with at least 6 clearly flat horizontal walkable platforms and strong playable collision geometry, lethal gaps and at least three elevations. Camera exactly SIDE ON, orthographic 2D, zero isometric or top-down perspective. Background stays simplified, desaturated and low contrast; foreground objects and characters sharply separated. Use repeatable consistent tiles and sprites, clear empty gaps for jumps, minimal restrained particles. HUD must be TINY and utilitarian, confined to corners, leave 92% of image for the actual game; no big logo, no large title or style label inside image, no interface cards, no bottom controls. No horses. No gore or realistic firearms. The pink nose, ears or snout must clearly identify the hero as a pig, but radically vary the character design across the requested direction.

Authentic low-resolution 2D PIXEL ART, native 480x270 framebuffer enlarged by integer nearest-neighbor, chunky readable 24x28 pixel characters. Enemies: four little purple maintenance robots. Strict square pixels throughout.
